section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Drive for Muscularity Scale (DMS) used with men, noting the Malay translation and that scores were reverse-coded and combined into an overall DMS score. It reports that the Malay DMS has two highly correlated factors in the present study (subscale r = .67) and that internal consistency (omega) for the overall DMS in the present study was .88 (95% CI = .87-.90).
section_summary.evidence_source: Men were asked to complete the Drive for Muscularity Scale (DMS; McCreary & Sasse, 2000; Malay translation: Swami, Barron et al., 2016; Swami, Ng et al., 2016). Like the parent English version, scores on the Malay translation of the DMS has been found to reduce to two highly-correlated factors (Swami, Barron et al., 2016), both of which load onto a higher-order drive for muscularity dimension (present study subscale r = .67). In the present study, omega for the overall DMS scores in men was .88 (95% CI = .87-.90).
